description: This file defines the 'Module' entity class for the OrangeHRM system, mapping to the 'ohrm_module' database table. It includes properties for id, name, displayName, and status, along with their respective getter and setter methods.

classes.name: Module
classes.description: Represents a system module with properties for id, name, displayName, and status, mapped to database columns via Doctrine ORM annotations.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the id of the module.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the id of the module.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the module.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the module.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the status (enabled/disabled) of the module.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the status (enabled/disabled) of the module.

methods.name: getDisplayName
methods.description: Returns the display name of the module.

methods.name: setDisplayName
methods.description: Sets the display name of the module.
